_about: Firnlab vault — the open tools PT and the tools PT builds rely on, each pinned to a release, checksummed and licence-checked once a month (tools/vault_mirror.py, .github/workflows/vault.yml). Chosen by the owner on 25 Oct 2026. 'licence' is what we expect to find in the LICENSE file at the pinned tag; a mismatch turns the run red. 'use' is what PT may write into a build brief.

tools.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
tools.use: laptop only; drives Ghidra/IDA/Hopper for native binaries, reads JS/Electron and .NET statically; only on software the owner owns and whose licence allows; findings go to the model provider

tools.name: Ghidra
tools.install: unzip the release; needs a JDK 21
tools.use: the disassembler REA drives; same rules as REA

tools.name: mitmproxy
tools.use: observe an app's own network traffic for interoperability (public APIs, formats); never to bypass a protection

tools.name: jadx
tools.use: read Android packages for the open-device route; same rules as REA

tools.name: Frida
tools.use: live instrumentation of a running app on the owner's own device only; rarely, and never where the licence or terms forbid it

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.use: weekly red-team of PT's prompts and every tool's brief against the OWASP LLM attack classes; runs locally

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.use: secret scanning in every firnlab repository next to the data guard

tools.name: garak
tools.use: second LLM vulnerability scanner with a broader probe set; heavier, for the quarterly deep pass

tools.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
tools.use: the attack classes PT's proof rules and red-team cases cite; re-read monthly

tools.name: Claude Code GitHub Action
tools.use: build-without-a-chat: a GitHub issue labelled build becomes a pull request; runs on the owner's subscription token, stored only in GitHub secrets

tools.name: MCP reference servers
tools.use: filesystem, fetch, git, memory, time for tools PT builds

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.use: do-it-for-me in the browser on the laptop, with a gate at every irreversible step

tools.name: Activepieces
tools.use: self-hosted automation with MCP as the free alternative to paid Zapier/n8n; the ee folder is commercial and is not used

tools.name: faster-whisper
tools.use: dictation inside a tool, on the laptop; the clean-room base for a dictation tool

tools.name: whisper.cpp
tools.use: dictation in a native or offline tool

tools.name: Kokoro TTS
tools.use: speech out at zero credits; weights under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face

tools.name: Ollama
tools.use: AI inside a tool at zero credits on the laptop

tools.name: Capacitor
tools.use: PWA to native app for kit 4; EU direct install

tools.name: Expo
tools.use: native apps for kit 4; EAS free tier

tools.name: Vite
tools.use: the build tool for kit 3 web apps

tools.name: Cloudflare workers-sdk (wrangler)
tools.use: Cloudflare Pages and Workers for kit 3 hosting

tools.name: Chart.js
tools.use: charts inside tools PT builds
